name: Recycled cells
blurb: 100 000 items in a SkiaScroll, RecyclingTemplate + MeasureFirst, UseCache=Image

name: Uneven cells
blurb: Rows of different heights — MeasureVisible over 200 posts, ImageDoubleBuffered cells

name: Images
blurb: SkiaImage — every TransformAspect, alignment, clipping
demonstrates: custom CanvasKit filters built in code, an animated tile offset and the image preload queue

name: SVG
blurb: SkiaSvg — file and inline sources, TintColor, LockRatio

name: Shapes
blurb: SkiaShape — rectangle, circle, ellipse, arc, polygon, line, path; stroke, corner radii, clipping

name: Text
blurb: SkiaLabel — word wrap, MaxLines, alignment, spans, weights, glyph fallback

name: Layouts
blurb: Every SkiaLayout type — Absolute, Column, Row, Wrap, Grid (tracks, spans, spacing)
demonstrates: Wrap, Row, Grid and DecoratedGrid over recycled cell classes with Split changed from buttons, and an ImageComposite layer re-recording one spinning child

name: Common Controls
blurb: SkiaSwitch, SkiaCheckbox, SkiaRadioButton, SkiaProgress, SkiaSlider, SkiaButton — five styles

name: Carousel & Drawer
blurb: SkiaCarousel (swipe, SidesOffset peek, SelectedIndex) and SkiaDrawer (drag from an edge, snap by velocity)

name: Lottie & GIF
blurb: SkiaLottie (Skottie: AutoPlay, Repeat, SpeedRatio, IsOn, ColorTint) and SkiaGif frames on the canvas frame loop

name: Shell
blurb: SkiaShell — page transitions, OpenPopupAsync, PushModalAsync (drawer), ShowToast
demonstrates: page navigation, popups, modals, toasts and a tabbed shell driven from code

name: Editor
blurb: SkiaEditor — drawn text input: caret, selection, placeholder, password, multiline, ControlStyle looks

name: Keyboard Input
blurb: KeyboardManager — window-level KeyDown / KeyUp / KeyChar with modifier state, the Blazor sandbox probe

name: SkiaScroll
blurb: Header in flow / sticky / behind with parallax, Footer, scroll bars, pull to refresh, SnapToChildren, TrackIndexPosition

name: Shaders
blurb: SkiaShaderEffect — SkSL on any control (iImage1, iTime, iMouse, custom uniforms, touch ripples) and SkiaShaderCarousel gl-transitions
demonstrates: SkSL effects attached through VisualEffects, with uniforms, time and touch driven from code

name: Sprites
blurb: SkiaSprite spritesheets and a SkiaSpriteSet warrior on a tile board, moved with the keyboard (FastRepro sprites)
demonstrates: a SkiaSpriteSet warrior moved across the board with the keyboard

name: Transforms
blurb: Rotation, Scale, Skew, Translation, Opacity — hit-testing through them, *ToAsync animations

name: Drag to reorder
blurb: Language preferences, Android style: drag one by its grip and it lifts and floats over the list, which reorders live under it
demonstrates: reordering a list in place by dragging a row, the row lifted into a ghost that floats over the list

name: Accessibility
blurb: ARIA overlay over the canvas — roles, labels, hints, toggles, live regions, keyboard

name: Root menu
blurb: The demo site's own landing page — logo, title, subtitle and a card per sample
